knownPublicationDiscrepancies.note: Two legs of 6 mm at 175 mm give 2 x pi x 6^2/4 / 0.175 = 323.1 mm2/m, not 339. The published conclusion (provided >= required 317) still holds. The oracle reports the recomputed value and flags this field instead of matching it.
The intermediate is printed as 0.002 m2; 0.08 x sqrt(25)/500 x 0.25 m = 0.0002 m2/m. The final 200 mm2/m is consistent; only the intermediate is a typo.
The example cites 9.3.2(4); the beam rule is 9.2.2(6) (same expression). Value unaffected.
